en.t: Even so, he still could not make sense of it...

units.source_text: 想死都想不通，女人为什么会那么执着地待在那“冥河河岸”呢……

en.t: No matter how desperately he thought about it, he could not understand why the woman was so stubbornly determined to remain on that "bank of the River Styx"...

units.source_text: 说是“爱乡精神”，说是“情理”，把它们全抛弃的时候，有一些一起丧失的东西，才能称得上是丧失……

en.t: People might call it "love of one's native place" or "human feeling and reason," but only when there is something lost along with casting all of that away can it truly be called loss...

units.source_text: 究竟她拥有哪些可以失去的东西呢？

en.t: What, after all, did she have that she could lose?
